meta.phase-name: Unreal Placement Sync and Diagnostics Workflow

phase-summary.outcome: Defined the Unreal workflow against the shared spatial contract: stable managed placement ids, preview/diagnose/apply sync semantics, hand-authored map ownership boundaries, and plugin-local diagnostics for missing assets, classes, and transform conflicts.

file.description: Records the Unreal payload, ownership, and sync rules for later plugin implementation.
Decision log now includes the managed-placement-id and hand-authored-level ownership rules.

decision.summary: Stable generated placement ids are the authoritative identity for Unreal placement sync.
decision.impact: Later plugin work can update and reconcile placements deterministically.

tests.test: XML parse validation for 58-04-PLAN.xml and dependent planning docs.

next.action: Phase 58 is complete. Use the phase 58 plan and summary documents as the implementation contract for later spatial-schema, editor, and Unreal-plugin work.

suggestion.gap: REQUIREMENTS.xml does not yet capture the managed-placement-id sync contract.
suggestion.proposal: Add a requirement for preview/apply Unreal placement sync with stable placement ids and explicit managed actor boundaries.
